name: forensic-claim-audit
description: Forensic insurance claim auditing toolkit. Breaks the full supplement audit into 13 stage skills with shared Factual Integrity protocols, plus setup, intake, and final-delivery skills that produce the suggestion-list XLSX and the audit's end deliverable — a marked-up copy of the carrier's estimate with CCS's edits applied in-line (changes in green, a justification box under each).
